papers.title: Grey–Taguchi multi-response optimization of residual stress and compressive layer depth in ultrasonic rolling of Ti-6Al-4V
papers.abstract: Ultrasonic surface rolling (USR) is an effective surface treatment technique for improving the fatigue performance of metallic components through the introduction of compressive residual stress (CRS) and subsurface strengthening.However, simultaneous optimization of CRS magnitude and compressive layer depth in Ti-6Al-4V remains challenging because of the complex elastic-plastic behavior induced by coupled static and ultrasonic dynamic loading.In this study, an integrated analytical-statistical framework combining Hertzian contact theory, energybased dynamic impact analysis, and Grey-Taguchi multi-response optimization was developed to optimize the USR process parameters.The proposed analytical model was validated against experimental data reported in the literature and showed satisfactory agreement in predicting the residual stress distribution and compressive layer depth.Parametric analysis and ANOVA results indicate that vibration amplitude is the most influential factor (37.82%), followed by ultrasonic frequency and static load, whereas ball diameter has a comparatively minor effect.The predicted optimal parameter combination was identified as A = 10 μm, S = 460 N, F = 25 kHz, and D = 10 mm.Under these conditions, the maximum compressive residual stress and compressive layer depth reached approximately -711.8 MPa and 278 μm, respectively.The proposed framework provides both physical insight and practical guidance for the optimization of ultrasonic surface rolling parameters in Ti-6Al-4V components.
papers.venue: Advances in Science and Technology – Research Journal

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文针对Ti-6Al-4V超声滚压后处理工艺参数优化，直接关系到后处理对表层残余应力与疲劳性能的调控。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not include original experimental mechanical testing or fatigue data; it relies on literature data for validation and focuses on parameter optimization rather than directly measuring fatigue life.

summary_zh.motivation: 同时优化Ti-6Al-4V超声滚压后的残余应力与压应力层深度仍具挑战。
summary_zh.method: 结合Hertz接触理论与能量分析，采用灰田口多目标优化方法确定最优工艺参数。
summary_zh.result: 振幅影响最大，最优参数下最大压残余应力约-711.8 MPa，压应力层深度约278 μm。
summary_zh.validation: 与文献实验数据对比，模型预测残余应力分布和层深吻合良好。

summary_en.motivation: Simultaneous optimization of compressive residual stress magnitude and compressive layer depth in ultrasonic surface rolling of Ti-6Al-4V remains challenging due to complex elastic-plastic behavior.
summary_en.method: An integrated analytical-statistical framework combining Hertzian contact theory, energy-based dynamic impact analysis, and Grey-Taguchi multi-response optimization is developed.
summary_en.result: Vibration amplitude is the most influential parameter; the optimal combination yields maximum compressive residual stress of about -711.8 MPa and compressive layer depth of about 278 μm.
summary_en.validation: The analytical model is validated against experimental data from published literature, showing satisfactory agreement in predicting residual stress distribution and compressive layer depth.
